CgroupSnapshot.description:
One observation of the cgroup containing the adapter host. Its counters
include the cgroup's descendants and may include other workloads. Limits
cover only visible ancestors; ancestors hidden by namespaces are unknown.

cpu_throttled_microseconds.description: Cumulative CPU throttled time, in microseconds.

cpu_usage_microseconds.description: Cumulative cgroup CPU time, in microseconds.

memory_current_bytes.description: Hierarchically accounted memory, distinct from process RSS, in bytes.

memory_peak_bytes.description:
Provider high-water mark in bytes, since cgroup creation or the last
external reset. Never an invocation-specific peak.

oom_kills.description: Cumulative OOM kills in this cgroup hierarchy.

pressure_stall_microseconds.description:
Cumulative pressure-stall microseconds: cpu_some, cpu_full,
memory_some, memory_full, io_some, and io_full.

target.description: Device/inode identity. A different identity invalidates counter deltas.

visible_cpu_limit_cores.description:
Minimum of effective cpuset size and visible ancestor CPU quotas.
This is a visible upper bound, not reserved or exclusively usable CPU.

visible_memory_limit_bytes.description: Minimum memory.max among visible ancestors, in bytes.

CgroupStats.description:
Native cgroup observations and counter deltas over an invocation. Values
identify the adapter host's cgroup, without claiming container exclusivity.

cpu_throttled_microseconds.description: CPU throttled time delta in microseconds, or an explicit unknown reason.

cpu_usage_microseconds.description: CPU usage delta in microseconds, or an explicit unknown reason.

oom_kills.description: OOM-kill counter delta, or an explicit unknown reason.

ContainerSoftwareReport.description: Existing environment-owner report of a container engine server.

context_refs.description: Installation contexts served by this engine.

engine_version.description: Server version, never a CLI or API version.

metadata.description: Adapter or runtime metadata useful for diagnostics.

retryable.description: Whether NeMo Fabric considers this failure safe for a consumer-level retry.

stage.description: NeMo Fabric lifecycle stage where the failure surfaced.

ExecutionEvidence.description: Selected software evidence included inline in a RunResult.

infrastructure.description: Existing provider/engine reports, omitted when none were supplied.

software_environments.description: One inventory per observed installation/resolution context.

FabricEvent.description: NeMo Fabric lifecycle or progress event.

GaugeSummary.description:
A sampled gauge over the invocation window. Min/max cover retained valid
samples. Mean holds the previous value only across adjacent valid samples
no more than twice the requested cadence apart. Missing intervals never
contribute zero. No sampled maximum claims a true process high-water mark.

covered_fraction.description: Covered seconds divided by invocation duration.

covered_seconds.description: Seconds covered by valid adjacent readings.

final_value.description: Final endpoint, absent if its reading failed.

sampled_peak.description: Maximum retained value, not an unsampled high-water mark.

time_weighted_mean.description: Hold-last-value integral divided by covered seconds, or unknown.

unit.description: `byte` for RSS or `process` for process count.

valid_samples.description: Number of valid retained readings for this metric.

container.description: Included only when an owner supplied an engine report.

sandbox.description: Included only when an owner supplied a sandbox report.

oneOf.description: The selected report was received.
Expected evidence was unavailable.
This boundary has no supported reporter.
Collection did not run.

InvocationSystemStats.description:
System measurements around one invocation, collected inside the executing
runner. Process-tree observations cover its adapter host and descendants,
excluding the orchestrator and remote model/service processes. The separate
cgroup observations may include other workloads in the same cgroup.

Endpoints are instantaneous readings, not peaks or time averages. CPU time
is cumulative since runtime startup; its difference is only an estimate
because process reaping and reparenting can change which work is visible.

after.description:
Observation immediately after the adapter exchange, before another
invocation can acquire this runtime's host lock.

before.description: Observation immediately before the adapter exchange.

cgroup.description:
Before/after readings for the adapter host's cgroup. This scope may
contain other workloads and overlaps the process tree; never add them.

collected_groups.description: Requested groups, including selected groups unavailable on this platform.

cpu_time_seconds_estimate.description:
Nonnegative CPU counter difference, in seconds. Absent if an endpoint
is missing, the runtime identity differs, or its CPU counter decreased.
It can undercount work whose processes leave the tree between reads.

elapsed_seconds.description:
Monotonic elapsed seconds for the adapter exchange. Excludes runtime
startup, endpoint collection, artifact preparation, and teardown.
Optional sampling runs concurrently; its effect is not subtracted.

sampled.description: Bounded sample reductions and collection quality when sampling is enabled.

Measurement.description:
A measured value or its availability. Unlimited is distinct from unknown
and is used only for limits. No missing measurement is replaced with zero.

oneOf.description: Its metric group was explicitly excluded from collection.
A value was read successfully.

value.description: Observed numeric value, with units defined by its containing field.

oneOf.description: No limit is configured in the visible hierarchy.

reason.description: Safe reason the reading is unknown.

ResourceObservation.description:
One attempt to observe the adapter host process tree. Missing readings are
explicit; an unavailable observation never stands for zero resource usage.

oneOf.description: The process group was explicitly excluded from collection.
The process tree was read successfully.

snapshot.description: Timestamped cumulative counters and instantaneous gauges.

oneOf.description: The reader supports this runtime, but could not read its process tree.

reason.description: Why this observation could not be collected.

The harness completed successfully.

RunUsage.description: Normalized invocation usage exposed to NeMo Fabric consumers.

cached_input_tokens.description: Cached input tokens consumed by the invocation, when reported.

cost_usd.description: Invocation cost in US dollars when reported by the provider.

input_tokens.description: Input tokens consumed by the invocation.

input_tokens_include_cache.description: Whether input_tokens already includes cached_input_tokens; absent means unknown.

output_tokens.description: Output tokens produced by the invocation.

total_tokens.description: Total tokens reported by the provider.

RuntimeResourceSnapshot.description:
Timestamped resource usage of one runtime's local adapter host process tree.

Memory, process count, and CPU time cover the adapter host process and its
live descendants. For a runtime started on a service, the shared service
process is not included. Values NeMo Fabric cannot read are returned as an
error, never as zero.

cpu_time_seconds.description:
CPU time consumed by the tree since the adapter host started, in seconds,
including exited descendants. It can drop when a descendant leaves the
tree.

observed_at.description: When NeMo Fabric read these values, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.

process_count.description:
Live processes in the tree, including the adapter host. Exited processes
that are not yet reaped are not counted.

resident_memory_bytes.description:
Sum of the resident set sizes of the live processes, in bytes. Pages
shared between processes count once per process.

started_at.description: When NeMo Fabric started the runtime's adapter host, as an RFC 3339 UTC timestamp.

SampleSummary.description:
Resource series retention, reductions, and collection quality. Resource
samples remain in the referenced JSONL artifact for interval selection.

cgroup_target_continuous.description:
Whether retained readings kept one cgroup identity with nondecreasing
counters and no gaps over twice cadence. This does not prove exclusivity.

collection_seconds.description: Total time spent collecting retained observations, including endpoints.

cpu_percent_one_core.description: 100% means one fully occupied CPU core; this is not normalized by quota.

cpu_time_seconds_estimate.description:
Estimated CPU counter delta, invalidated by observed resets, missing
endpoints, target changes, or collection gaps larger than twice cadence.

diagnostics.description: Safe collection/persistence diagnostics. They never change agent status.

dropped_samples.description: Samples skipped because collection fell behind or retention was full.

largest_gap_seconds.description: Maximum observed interval between retained readings.

sample_count.description: Retained samples, including unavailable readings and endpoints.

samples.description: Series artifact, absent when its file could not be created or fully written.

target_interval_ms.description: Requested cadence; actual timing is retained in sample offsets.

truncated.description: Whether collection or retention prevented a complete series.

SandboxSoftwareReport.description: Existing sandbox/provider report, without any new service discovery.

context_refs.description: Installation contexts served by this sandbox.

service_version.description: Gateway/service version, not a guest package version.

SoftwareEntry.description: One selected component in an installation inventory.

SoftwareEnvironment.description: An observed installation/resolution context, never inferred from equal versions.

complete.description: Every selected target is represented, including unavailable versions.

context_ref.description: Opaque result-local join key; has no machine or role semantics.

entries.description: Selected software only; this is not a dependency scan.

participants.description: Components using this installation, such as `caller_sdk` or `adapter`.

reason.description: Why coverage is unavailable or incomplete.

status.description: Report availability. `not_applicable` is not an inventory status.

SystemStatsMetricGroup.description: Resource groups supported by the native invocation collector.

Cgroup CPU capacity, usage, and throttling.

Cgroup CPU, memory, and I/O pressure counters.

TelemetryRef.description: Reference to telemetry emitted by Relay or another configured telemetry path.

kind.description: Reference category in the public SDK representation.

provider.description: Provider in the public SDK reference representation.

relay_enabled.description: Whether Relay was enabled for this run; retained for native compatibility.

VersionObservation.description: A full version or an explicit reason why it could not be captured.

observed_at.description: Original RFC 3339 UTC capture time; forwarding does not change it.

origin.description: How the named source obtained this observation.

reason.description: Required when a value is missing.

value.description: Full value, present only when available; never shortened or hashed.

description: Result from a NeMo Fabric-managed harness invocation.

adapter_id.description: Adapter implementation id when an adapter descriptor was resolved.

artifacts.description: Artifacts produced or collected by this run.

events.description: NeMo Fabric lifecycle/progress events emitted during the run.

execution.description: Selected software evidence. Absent in older results and when collection is disabled.

harness.description: Stable machine-readable harness identifier used for this run.

resource_snapshot.description:
Resource snapshot of the runtime, read once after the adapter returned this
result. Absent when the runtime's resources could not be observed.

system_stats.description:
Invocation duration and endpoint observations from the executing runner.
Absent in older results and when an execution backend does not collect them.

usage.description: Normalized invocation usage when reported by the adapter target.
